summary.name: Kimi WebSearch and Fetch Tools
summary.one_liner: Pricing and billing rules for Kimi API Platform's web-search, Web Search Pro, and URL fetch tools, billed per successful call.
use_cases: add live web search to a Kimi model
estimate API costs for search-enabled apps
extract page content as markdown for an LLM
restrict search results to specific sites or time ranges
budget per-call charges for AI agents
summary.what_it_does: The page explains how Kimi API Platform bills its web search and URL fetch tools, with each channel billed separately per call. Web Search Basic and Web Search Pro (/v1/tools/search and /v1/tools/search_pro) are charged one call when the request returns HTTP 200 with non-empty results. Web Search Pro adds site restriction, time-window filtering, and structured content chunks. URL Fetch (/v1/tools/fetch) is charged when the response contains non-blank markdown. The page also covers the Responses API web_search tool, which charges only when a search actually runs, and the Formula API web-search tool used with kimi-k3. Model input and output tokens are still billed normally when search runs through the Responses or Formula APIs.
notable: Billed only for successful calls with non-empty results or non-blank fetched content
Web Search Pro supports sites filter, time_window, and structured chunks
Responses API and Formula API still bill model tokens separately
caveats: Prices exclude applicable taxes, calculated at checkout by jurisdiction
Failed, rate-limited, timed-out, or empty requests are not billed but may still need handling
Formula API web-search is tied to kimi-k3 model usage
